layout.desktop: identity board plus synchronized evidence index, irregular specimens, and capability matrix
layout.mobile: single measured track with two-by-two project index

motion.hero: single staged GSAP calibration with split-line resolve, registration sweep, and clip reveal

decisions: Desktop navigation labels include chapter numbers; mobile navigation remains compact.
Education is one mineral academic dossier with four numbered records and a cobalt lead record.
The CV preview retains original colors while the summary uses cobalt with navy text.
The hero closes with one lime kinetic capability rail driven by scroll; it reuses existing proof points and stops under reduced motion.
Project media carries an oversized real project title, while the evidence index inherits the active project's signal color.
Capabilities use three staggered horizontal scanner rows with numbered proof skills instead of equal cards.
Experience uses six alternating CV-backed records with oversized chapter numerals, and contact opens with a factual availability signal bar.
Education closes with a factual SMX to AI progression rail, and the CV bar links directly to ES, CA, and EN documents.
Mobile opens with a panoramic identity portrait before the thesis so Marc is visible in the first viewport.
Motion behaves as calibration: one hero scan, scroll-synchronized project inspection, measured progress, no new ambient loops, and a static reduced-motion fallback.

must: Keep Spanish, Catalan, and English equivalent
Use only verifiable project claims and working links
Preserve bubble cursor, atmospheric background, keyboard focus, and reduced motion
Preserve portrait, CV, and flag colors
avoid: Invented metrics, clients, screenshots, or outcomes
Decorative dashboards, fake terminals, carousels, or modals
